## 3bc699429714

**Reproduced defect — false override contract and dead helpful textures.** Generator SHA-256 `b282f20fa9b2518d223e346029b321753e9f79cf1b580693677938eff79522d3`; selected rule hash `260a6d8977a7`.

The supported override check failed with **4,313 findings over 35,730 draws and 397 cases**. Examples include declared grid sizes rejected by difficulty-specific draw ranges, degenerate textures ignoring requested dimensions, `num_blobs` and `n_distinct_colors` lacking keyed provenance and being inert, all four helpful `palette_kind` values being inert in mixed sweeps, and an unknown override key being accepted. Strict defect lint independently flagged four byte-identical helpful textures, ordinary/degenerate texture-domain overlap, an undeclared lawful line case, and no `RULE_HASH` pin.

This also leaves a plausible training shortcut: every ordinary sample contains exactly two solid, distinctly colored rectangles in fixed diagonal regions, despite metadata claiming 2–3 blobs and broader controls. A learner can memorize “erase each rectangle interior” without learning general connected-component bounding boxes.

Evidence: `checks/audit/3bc699429714/finding.json`, `checks/audit/3bc699429714/override.log`, and `checks/audit/3bc699429714/defect_lint.log`.
